sections.Profile:
The World Fair pinball machine, released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in 1964, was designed by Wayne Neyens with artwork by Roy Parker. This electro-mechanical game was created to commemorate the excitement surrounding the 1964 New York World's Fair.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1964
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
